name: Sex differences in the genetic architecture of cognitive resilience to Alzheimer’s disease
description:
This dataset contains the sex stratified and interaction summary statistics memory and memory slopes. 
All GWAS described were performed in males, in females, and with a sex-interaction and were run in the combined autopsy dataset and in the combined PET dataset for all resilience phenotypes including cognitive normal phenotypes. Sex-stratified GWAS covaried for age and the first three genetic principal components.
